reviewed_by: Codex manual original API definitions, exact mutation hunks, full upstream verification scope and bounded concrete observations2026-10-25
selection_note: Different production-symbol contracts; excludes existing datetime2properties, _field2parameter, nested2properties and field2nullable families, same-function variants and simple read/write mirrors.

tasks.trigger: Normalize a docstring with unequal indentation and an empty input.
tasks.wrong: Maximum indentation removes significant text and empty input returns a literal None string.
tasks.causal: Use minimum nonempty indentation, preserve relative indentation and return empty text for blank input.
tasks.observation:
from apispec.utils import trim_docstring
value=trim_docstring('
    summary
      detail
    end
')
print('trimmed_docstring',repr(value))
assert value=='summary
  detail
end'
assert trim_docstring('  
')==''

tasks.trigger: Build the same schema reference under OpenAPI two and three.
tasks.wrong: The version condition and lookup version are shifted, and the name is reversed.
tasks.causal: Select the namespace by major version and preserve the exact component name.

tasks.trigger: Normalize absent, scalar-string and already plural JSON Schema type values.
tasks.wrong: None stays None, a scalar string stays scalar and an existing list becomes nested.
tasks.causal: Return an empty list for None, wrap only strings and preserve an existing type collection.

tasks.trigger: Combine overlapping range validators into one schema range.
tasks.wrong: Lower and upper bound attributes are crossed when collecting validators.
tasks.causal: Use the greatest lower bound and least upper bound across nonempty bounds.

tasks.trigger: Obtain fields from an initialized Schema instance and from a Schema class.
tasks.wrong: Instance fields are unnecessarily deep-copied, class fields remain shared and dump-only filtering is reversed.
tasks.causal: Preserve instance-owned field identity, copy class declarations and pass the original exclusion flag.
tasks.observation:
from marshmallow import Schema,fields
from apispec.ext.marshmallow.common import get_fields
class Item(Schema):
 value=fields.Integer()
 output=fields.String(dump_only=True)
instance=Item()
instance_fields=get_fields(instance)
class_fields=get_fields(Item)
print('field_ownership',instance_fields['value'] is instance.fields['value'],class_fields['value'] is Item._declared_fields['value'])
assert instance_fields['value'] is instance.fields['value']
assert class_fields['value'] is not Item._declared_fields['value']
assert 'output' not in get_fields(Item,exclude_dump_only=True)

tasks.trigger: Register a custom parameter converter that expects the converter instance as self.
tasks.wrong: The public attribute remains an unbound function and the callback precedes built-ins.
tasks.causal: Bind the function to this converter and append it after existing parameter attribute functions.
tasks.observation:
from apispec import APISpec
from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
from marshmallow import Schema,fields,validate
plugin=MarshmallowPlugin()
spec=APISpec(title='demo',version='1',openapi_version='3.0.3',plugins=[plugin])
converter=plugin.converter
def extra(self,field,ret):
 return {'x-extra':self is converter}
before=list(converter.parameter_attribute_functions)
converter.add_parameter_attribute_function(extra)
print('callback_binding',getattr(converter.extra,'__self__',None) is converter)
assert converter.extra.__self__ is converter
assert converter.parameter_attribute_functions[:-1]==before
assert converter.parameter_attribute_functions[-1]==converter.extra
assert converter.extra(fields.Integer(),ret={})=={'x-extra':True}

tasks.trigger: Register immediate and deferred schema components.
tasks.wrong: The active/lazy buffers are exchanged and component identity is copied.
tasks.causal: Place each component in the requested buffer and retain its identity until ordinary lazy activation.

from apispec import APISpec
spec=APISpec(title='demo',version='1',openapi_version='3.0.3')
component={'type':'string'}
spec.components._register_component('schema','Now',component,lazy=False)
spec.components._register_component('schema','Later',component,lazy=True)
print('registration_buffers',list(spec.components.schemas),list(spec.components.schemas_lazy))
assert spec.components.schemas['Now'] is component
assert spec.components.schemas_lazy['Later'] is component and 'Later' not in spec.components.schemas
reference=spec.components.get_ref('schema','Later')
assert reference=={'$ref':'#/components/schemas/Later'}
assert spec.components.schemas['Later'] is component and 'Later' not in spec.components.schemas_lazy

from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
from marshmallow import Schema,fields,validate
plugin=MarshmallowPlugin()
spec=APISpec(title='demo',version='1',openapi_version='3.0.3',plugins=[plugin])
converter=plugin.converter
class Pet(Schema):
 name=fields.String()
